title: Detroit musicians he met
summary: He names Hank Jones, Barry Harris, Tommy Flanagan, Wardell Gray, Billy Mitchell and Doug Watkins in Detroit.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I’d like to go back to Detroit for just one moment. While you were there playing with Juice Jones, you were singing jazz.
Who were some of the more well-known Detroit musicians that you met or played with during those times?
Barry Harris. Barry Harris was working at a place called the Bluebird, I think. Tommy Flanagan, too, was there – were there.
Yeah. There were some wonderful musicians in Detroit. Wardell Gray, Billy Mitchell. Some wonderful horn players too.

Billy Mitchell plays tenor. There were some good trumpet players. There was a family of bass players. Doug Watkins was one of the younger members of that family. I forget some of the names, but there’s always – there were some great musicians working around there. It was really wonderful. It was a great time for me. I had a wonderful time.
